title: WoW File Frontmatter
description: Schema for Ways of Working as Code file frontmatter (YAML)

id.description: Unique identifier for this WoW rule. Kebab-case. Used for inheritance matching across levels.

title.description: Human-readable title of the WoW rule.

enforcement.description: How agents should treat this rule. 'hard' = block/warn (cannot be relaxed by lower levels). 'soft' = suggest (can be overridden). 'info' = reference only.

owner.description: Team or person responsible for this rule. Use @ handle or team name.

applies_to.description: Triggers that determine when an agent should load this rule.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date when this rule was last reviewed by the owner.

tags.description: Cross-cutting concerns that don't fit into a single category.
